title: Predictor v3.1 candle signals + P(rug) at candle opens, held to the candle close
data: launches created at or after registered_at_unix, recorded by `tartar record --track-minutes 120` (chain source, SOLANA_COMMITMENT=processed) into data/raw-pred, archived by hour to handoff/data/raw-pred
success: primary rule: at least 100 trades AND the 90% bootstrap interval (resampling tokens) of mean net return per trade lies entirely above 0. Otherwise NOT CONFIRMED. The secondary rule is reported, never a success criterion.
stop: evaluate once, when the primary rule has >= 100 trades on fresh launches or on 2026-10-12, whichever comes first; before that, look only at the trade count (`evaluate --count-only`)
